decisions.reason: The request for guidance about a copyright process does not change the existing KDP metadata, upload, or submission-support obligations.
Copyright-process guidance does not alter the paperback cover deliverable, presentation, review, or responsibility.
The client asks about a copyright process comparable to obtaining an ISBN; she does not change the copyright page's content, alignment, email, website, or attribution.
The copyright-process question does not change any manuscript editing objective or approved rewrite.
The source decision does not affect chapter-image selection, tone assessment, or colour-palette review.
Copyright guidance has no effect on Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, capitalization, or subtitle formatting.
The copyright-process question does not alter image aspect-ratio, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The source decision does not change whether, when, or where chapter images are placed.
The request for copyright guidance does not affect the italic styling of Mama's Hot Take text.
The source decision does not change paragraph spacing or page-density preferences.
The copyright-process question does not alter the title page or the removal of the literal newline artifact.
The copyright-guidance request does not designate a new authoritative manuscript revision or change revision-integration requirements.
